# EduExpress International

> Evidence-first study abroad consultancy for students and families in Bangladesh, based in Dhanmondi, Dhaka since 2018. EduExpress compares education quality, recognition, the full cost and visa readiness before recommending a route, puts every cost in writing, and charges BDT 0 service fee before China visa approval (and BDT 0 EduExpress service charge for Malaysia university applications & EMGS guidance). Admission, scholarship and visa outcomes are never guaranteed.

Key facts:
- Founded 8 March 2018 by Abdullah Al Rakib (Founder and CEO); China & Malaysia specialist with 12 active destination services. Independent Bangladeshi company unaffiliated with unrelated companies named EduExpress registered in the UK.
- Associations: Founding Member (#08) of the China Bangladesh Consultancy Alliance (CBCA, https://cbcabd.org/) and verified Active Member (ID: FCM-452) of the Foreign Admission & Career Development Consultants Association of Bangladesh (FACD-CAB, https://www.facdcab.org/members/directory/2264). Verified International Directory Profile: UniAgents (https://www.uniagents.com/en/consultants/eduexpress-international.htm).
- Office: Evergreen Latif, House 12/1, Road 4/A, Ground Floor, Dhanmondi, Dhaka 1209, Bangladesh. Open Saturday to Thursday, 11:00 AM to 6:00 PM.
- Phone / WhatsApp: +880 1983-333566, +880 1329-663505. Email: info@eduexpressint.com
- Free first assessment. Fees, inclusions and refund terms: https://eduexpressint.com/pricing.md
- Full reference with guide answers, intakes and the university directory: https://eduexpressint.com/llms-full.txt
- XML sitemap index: https://eduexpressint.com/sitemap.xml

## Start here

- [Free education fit assessment](https://eduexpressint.com/education-fit-assessment): share results, budget and goals; a counsellor replies within one working day
- [University application support](https://eduexpressint.com/apply): request an eligibility, document and fee schedule review for your target university
- [Education consultant in Dhanmondi, Dhaka](https://eduexpressint.com/education-consultant-dhaka): local Dhaka consultancy overview and in-person booking
- [Fees and transparency](https://eduexpressint.com/fees-and-transparency): what EduExpress charges, when, and what is paid to third parties
- [China visa-first payment policy](https://eduexpressint.com/china-visa-first-policy): no EduExpress service fee before China visa approval
- [Contact and office visit](https://eduexpressint.com/contact): address, hours, phone, WhatsApp and map

## Study in China (flagship)

- [Study in China from Bangladesh](https://eduexpressint.com/study-in-china-from-bangladesh): the complete starting guide
- [Study in China agency in Bangladesh](https://eduexpressint.com/study-in-china-agency-bangladesh): how to verify China education consultancies in Dhaka, Visa-First fee terms (BDT 0 before visa), and 6-step transparent workflow
- [China March 2027 intake](https://eduexpressint.com/china-march-2027-intake): active Spring 2027 deadlines, university majors and study plans
- [Cost of studying in China](https://eduexpressint.com/study-in-china-cost-bangladesh): tuition, hostel, insurance, visa and travel budgeting
- [China scholarships](https://eduexpressint.com/china-scholarships-bangladesh): CSC, provincial and university awards and what they cover
- [CSC scholarship from Bangladesh](https://eduexpressint.com/csc-scholarship-bangladesh): Chinese Government Scholarship steps and documents
- [Complete CSC universities list 2027 (306 schools)](https://eduexpressint.com/updates/complete-csc-universities-list-2027): 2027 cycle directory of 306 designated Chinese universities accepting Chinese Government Scholarship (CSC) applications
- [CSC Type A bilateral scholarship guide](https://eduexpressint.com/updates/how-to-apply-csc-type-a-scholarship-complete-guide): step-by-step bilateral nomination route from Bangladesh
- [China admission requirements](https://eduexpressint.com/china-admission-requirements): documents and entry rules by level
- [China student visa (X1/X2)](https://eduexpressint.com/china-student-visa-bangladesh): visa preparation from Bangladesh
- [Study in China without IELTS](https://eduexpressint.com/study-in-china-without-ielts): English-proof routes that are accepted
- [MBBS in China](https://eduexpressint.com/mbbs-in-china-bangladesh): medical universities, fees and BMDC considerations
- [China intakes and deadlines](https://eduexpressint.com/china-intakes-deadlines): March and September 2027 windows with live status
- [Life in China for Bangladeshi students](https://eduexpressint.com/life-in-china-bangladeshi-students): housing, food, safety and part-time rules
- [2027 CSCA entrance exam guide](https://eduexpressint.com/updates/csca-guide-study-in-china): China Scholastic Competency Assessment (CSCA) syllabus, schedule, fees and scoring — EduExpress provides a complimentary CSCA Master Pro seat activation code (CNY 99 value on https://www.cscamaster.com/) when students open a verified China application file at BDT 0 file-opening charge
- [China K-Visa for STEM graduates](https://eduexpressint.com/updates/china-k-visa): eligibility, documents and application steps for qualified Bangladeshi STEM graduates
- [China universities](https://eduexpressint.com/china-universities): profiles with programmes, fees, city guides and scholarships
- [China student success stories](https://eduexpressint.com/china-success-stories): consented student admission cases with privacy-safe records
- [Bangladesh to China Study Data & Cost Report](https://eduexpressint.com/china-study-report-bangladesh): live catalogue benchmark across 353 Chinese universities (306/306 CSC-designated), explicit CNY tuition quartiles, non-tuition charges, scholarships and verification counts ([JSON dataset](https://eduexpressint.com/china-study-report.json))
- [বাংলা গাইড (Study in China in Bengali)](https://eduexpressint.com/bn/study-in-china): চীন পড়াশোনা, খরচ ও ভিসার সম্পূর্ণ বাংলা গাইড
- [চায়না স্টুডেন্ট ভিসা গাইড (বাংলা)](https://eduexpressint.com/bn/china-student-visa-bangladesh): X1/X2 ভিসা ও JW202 ধাপসমূহ
- [চীনে পড়াশোনার খরচ (বাংলা)](https://eduexpressint.com/bn/study-in-china-cost-bangladesh): টিউশন, হোস্টেল ও বাজেট হিসাব
- [CSC স্কলারশিপ গাইড (বাংলা)](https://eduexpressint.com/bn/csc-scholarship-bangladesh): বাংলাদেশি শিক্ষার্থীদের জন্য CSC Type A ও Type B নিয়ম
- [চীনে MBBS গাইড (বাংলা)](https://eduexpressint.com/bn/mbbs-in-china-bangladesh): MoE স্বীকৃতি, টিউশন ও BMDC নিবন্ধন প্রক্রিয়া
- [CSCA ভর্তি পরীক্ষার গাইড (বাংলা)](https://eduexpressint.com/bn/csca-exam-bangladesh): চীনে আন্ডারগ্র্যাজুয়েট ভর্তি পরীক্ষা CSCA-এর সিলেবাস, ঢাকা সময়সূচি (UTC+6), ফি পেমেন্ট ও ফ্রি CSCA Master Pro প্রস্তুতি
- [SSC ও দাখিলের পর চীনে ৩+২ ডিপ্লোমা ও ব্যাচেলর (বাংলা)](https://eduexpressint.com/bn/study-in-china-after-ssc-dakhil): SSC, দাখিল ও O-Level পাসের পর ৫ বছরে ব্যাচেলর রুট, ৩টি স্কলারশিপ স্তর (থাকা-খাওয়া আলাদা) ও অনূর্ধ্ব-১৮ গার্ডিয়ান নিয়ম

## Study in Malaysia (zero EduExpress service fee)

- [Study in Malaysia from Bangladesh](https://eduexpressint.com/study-in-malaysia-from-bangladesh): public, private & UK/AU branch campuses, RM/BDT costs and BDT 0 service fee terms
- [Malaysia study costs & Bangladesh Bank Student File](https://eduexpressint.com/malaysia-study-cost-bangladesh): tuition, EMGS fees, Student File remittance and living budget in MYR and BDT
- [Malaysia student visa (EMGS & VAL)](https://eduexpressint.com/malaysia-student-visa-bangladesh): eVAL approval stages, SEV at Malaysian High Commission and e-Visa steps
- [Study in Malaysia after O-Level](https://eduexpressint.com/study-in-malaysia-after-o-level): 1-year Foundation (5 O-Level credits) and 2-year Diploma (3 credits) routes to skip 2 years of A-Levels, with tuition kept separate from living costs

## Plan and compare

- [Bangladesh Study Abroad Market 2027 Report](https://eduexpressint.com/bangladesh-study-abroad-market): outbound mobility trends, all 12 active destinations, separated BDT/local tuition vs. living budgets, Bangladesh Bank Student File vs. China payment rules, SSC/O-Level to PhD pathways, and B2B desk overview ([JSON dataset](https://eduexpressint.com/bangladesh-study-abroad-market.json))
- [বাংলাদেশ থেকে বিদেশে উচ্চশিক্ষা ও মার্কেট গাইড ২০২৭ (বাংলা)](https://eduexpressint.com/bn/bangladesh-study-abroad-market): ১২টি দেশের টিউশন ও থাকা-খাওয়ার আলাদা হিসাব, বাংলাদেশ ব্যাংক স্টুডেন্ট ফাইল নিয়ম, SSC/HSC ও O/A-Level রুট এবং অভিভাবক সতর্কতা
- [Study in China after O-Level or SSC (3+2 Diploma to Bachelor)](https://eduexpressint.com/study-in-china-after-o-level-ssc): 3-year Higher Vocational Diploma + 2-year Top-Up Bachelor (5 years total) with 3 tuition/hostel scholarship tiers (living costs separated) and under-18 guardian verification
- [China Bachelor vs. UK, USA, Australia, New Zealand & Dhaka Private Universities](https://eduexpressint.com/compare-bachelor-china-abroad-bangladesh): top-ranked Chinese universities with University/Provincial scholarships compared by rankings, facilities and separated tuition against NSU/EWU/AIUB and Western benchmarks
- [Study in Bangladesh vs. China (1-on-1 Bachelor Comparison)](https://eduexpressint.com/bangladesh-vs-china-bachelor-study): NSU, EWU, and AIUB 4-year fees compared directly against top-ranked Chinese universities, residential labs, university scholarships, and global Master's mobility (living costs separated)
- [Study in Bangladesh vs. Study Abroad Countries](https://eduexpressint.com/bangladesh-vs-study-abroad-countries): staying in Bangladesh (A-Levels & local private universities) compared against Malaysia, China, UK, Europe, USA, Australia, and New Zealand (living costs separated)
- [University and programme finder](https://eduexpressint.com/universities): search universities by subject, level, intake and scholarship
- [China program and tuition finder](https://eduexpressint.com/programs): every recorded China programme filtered by yearly tuition, language, city and deadline
- [Compare first-year costs & 32-country calculator](https://eduexpressint.com/compare-costs): side-by-side university fee comparison plus 32 global study destinations ([Embeddable Widget](https://eduexpressint.com/embed/cost-calculator))
- [Scholarship guidance and database](https://eduexpressint.com/scholarships): what awards cover, plus a searchable list of recorded China scholarships
- [All destinations](https://eduexpressint.com/destinations): China, United Kingdom, South Korea, Malaysia, Hungary, Finland, Cyprus, Croatia, Georgia, Malta, Greece, Thailand
- [Compare study destinations](https://eduexpressint.com/compare-study-destinations): cost and entry side by side
- [Your study journey](https://eduexpressint.com/your-study-journey): the seven stages from assessment to arrival
- [For parents](https://eduexpressint.com/for-parents): costs, safety and responsibilities explained for families

## Trust and policy

- [About EduExpress](https://eduexpressint.com/about): history, team and office
- [Media, Data & Research Press Room](https://eduexpressint.com/press): open CC BY 4.0 datasets, 4 bilingual press briefs, spokesperson bios and journalist verification desk
- [Zenodo Academic Dataset Archive (CERN DOI 10.5281/zenodo.24553975)](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24553975): permanent open-access CC BY 4.0 archive (Concept DOI [10.5281/zenodo.24423800](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24423800)) covering 416 verified universities across 12 active countries (including 306/306 CSC-designated Chinese universities), 1,974 programs, 1,609 fees, 791 scholarships and a 32-country global benchmark ([Zenodo Record](https://zenodo.org/records/24553975) · [GitHub Repo](https://github.com/rakibnuist/bangladesh-study-abroad-dataset) · [Kaggle Dataset](https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/abdullahalrakibww/bangladesh-study-abroad-china-cost-benchmark-2027))
- [How we verify universities](https://eduexpressint.com/how-we-verify-universities): sources and review dates behind every listed fact
- [Better Education Standard](https://eduexpressint.com/better-education-standard): how options are compared before recommending
- [Proof library](https://eduexpressint.com/proof-library): published company and office records
- [Complaints and resolution](https://eduexpressint.com/complaints-and-resolution): how to raise and escalate a complaint
- [Student data privacy](https://eduexpressint.com/student-data-privacy): how documents and personal data are handled
- [Country service status](https://eduexpressint.com/country-status): which destination services are active
